name: Backups
description: The adversary makes backups to prevent data loss in case things go bad.

subtechniques.name: Avoid cloud backups
subtechniques.description: Cloud backups are avoided for several reasons, such as the possibility that cloud environments could be seized by law enforcement agencies or that they keep version history which could reveal the existence of hidden volumes over time.

subtechniques.name: Avoid cloud syncing
subtechniques.description: Cloud syncing is avoided to prevent storing sensitive information in public cloud environments, such as passwords.

subtechniques.name: Backup at alternative location
subtechniques.description:
To prevent data loss and have the ability to recover data and systems, multiple backups should be made and at least one at a remote location.

subtechniques.name: Double backup
subtechniques.description:
Double backups might be made to prevent data loss. One backup might be stored on a remote location.

subtechniques.name: Make offline backup when system is turned off
Manual backup
subtechniques.description: Manual backups might be made instead of automatically to prevent to need to trust the computer.

subtechniques.name: Offline backup
subtechniques.description: Offline backups might be made to evade online attacks and have the ability to access data if an online system becomes compromised.

subtechniques.name: Only access online backups from secure devices or VM
subtechniques.description: To prevent any malware from spreading to sensitive information.

subtechniques.name: Snapshots
subtechniques.description: Snapshots capture the entire state of the virtual machine at the time you take the snapshot. You can take a snapshot when a virtual machine is powered on, powered off, or suspended. If you are suspending a virtual machine, wait until the suspend operation finishes before you take a snapshot.

subtechniques.name: Synchronization
subtechniques.description: Synchronization tools might be used to sync data between data storage.

procedures.description: DiskDigger can undelete and recover lost photos, videos, music, documents, and most other files that have been deleted. It can also recover files from corrupted or formatted flash drives, hard disks,, and memory cards https://www.diskdigger.org/download

procedures.name: SARDU MultiBoot Creator
procedures.description: SARDU MultiBoot Creator is a useful application designed to help you create an emergency rescue CD or USB drive. These drives can be used to check and to repair your system in case of a failure. https://www.sarducd.it/

procedures.description: CloneZilla is a partition and disk imaging/cloning program similar to True Image or Norton Ghost. It helps to do system deployment, bare metal backup and recovery. https://clonezilla.org/
